name: isContinuousValidationEnabled
definition: True when at least one NodeZero schedule is not disabled and has a non-disabled action that carries a cadence or cron expression.
population: The schedules in the NodeZero schedules page for one tenant.
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A schedule with is_disabled falsy and an action with is_disabled falsy and a cadence or cron_expression. A one-off op, or a schedule whose every action is disabled, is not enough.

changeLog.change: Registered so the Horizon3 NodeZero transforms can emit it; the meaning is what the transform reads, stated precisely. Unverified fields are named in notes.

notes: Only the NodeZero transform emits this key today. Field names are as that transform reads them; they were not live-verified against a NodeZero tenant, so the key stays proposed at V0 with the owner not yet named. This reads configuration: it shows a recurring test is set up, not that a recent run completed. With no schedules the transform returns false with dataCollection status success.
